title: Introducing Feedback Delays to Non-Delayed Adversarial MDPs: Optimal $\sqrt S$ and $\sqrt K$ Dependencies in Tabular and Linear AMDPs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17214v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study regret minimization in episodic Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (AMDPs) with unknown transitions and bandit feedback. In tabular AMDPs with $S$ states, $A$ actions, and horizon $H$, the best known $K$-episode regret is $\tilde O(HS\sqrt{AK})$, whose $\sqrt S$ gap to the $\Omega(H\sqrt{SAK})$ lower bound has long remained open. In linear AMDPs with $d$-dimensional features, after a five-year line of improvements starting from $K^{14/15}$, computationally efficient algorithms without a simulator or exploratory assumptions still only attain $\tilde O(K^{3/4})$ regret.   A common challenge in both settings is to estimate the Q-function of a changing policy: past data comes from earlier policies that differ from (and are correlated with) the current one, while freezing the policy for future episodes worsens the dependency on $K$. translated_title: 向非延迟对抗性马尔可夫决策过程引入反馈延迟：表格型与线性AMDP中的最优 $\sqrt S$ 与 $\sqrt K$ 依赖性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有未知转移和bandit反馈的情景式对抗性马尔可夫决策过程（AMDP）中的遗憾最小化问题。在具有 $S$ 个状态、$A$ 个动作和视野 $H$ 的表格型AMDP中，已知最好的 $K$ 轮遗憾为 $\tilde O(HS\sqrt{AK})$，其与 $\Omega(H\sqrt{SAK})$ 下界之间的 $\sqrt S$ 差距长期以来悬而未决。在具有 $d$ 维特征的线性AMDP中，从 $K^{14/15}$ 开始，经过五年的持续改进，在不依赖模拟器或探索性假设的情况下，计算高效的算法仍然只能达到 $\tilde O(K^{3/4})$ 的遗憾。这两种设置面临的一个共同挑战是如何估计一个不断变化的策略的Q函数：过去的数据来自与当前策略不同（且与之相关）的早期策略，而将策略冻结以供未来回合使用则会恶化对 $K$ 的依赖性。我们转而提出一种称为“引入反馈延迟”的通用技术：我们估计Q函数……
tldr: 本文提出一种称为“引入反馈延迟”的通用技术，通过延迟使用过去策略的数据来估计不断变化的策略的Q函数，从而在表格型AMDP中实现了匹配下界的最优 $\sqrt S$ 依赖，并在线性AMDP中实现了最优的 $\sqrt K$ 遗憾依赖，解决了这两个长期悬而未决的差距问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a general technique of "introduced feedback delays" to estimate the Q-function of a changing policy, achieving the optimal $\sqrt S$ dependence in tabular AMDPs (matching the $\Omega(H\sqrt{SAK})$ lower bound) and the optimal $\sqrt K$ regret dependence in linear AMDPs, resolving two long-standing gaps.
